items.docs:
Retrieves a list of all observations recorded for a specific project.
Observations are initial insights, ideas, or user behaviors noted by the team, which can later be developed into hypotheses.
Supports filtering by status, name, tags, and pagination.
The Knowledge Base article "Observations Feature Guide" explains: "Observations - Document initial insights directly."

items.docs:
Retrieves detailed information about a single observation, identified by its `observation_id`.
This includes its name, description, reference URL, status, associated tags, and any attachments (images/files).

items.docs:
Records a new observation within a project.
Requires a name, and can include a description, reference URL, status, tags, and attachments (images/files).
Observations are the first step in the ideation process, leading to hypotheses.
The Knowledge Base article "Observations Feature Guide" details this: "Observations serve as the starting point in documenting insights."
